ads.headline: Meta Ads interest surging; service businesses must capitalize now
actions: Audit your $25/day campaigns for underperforming ad sets and pause them immediately
Increase daily budget to $35-40/day on top 3 converting plumber/landscaper campaigns this week
Create 2 new local service ads targeting 'emergency' keywords (burst pipe, urgent cleaning) while competition is distracted
ads.source: Google Trends spike in 'meta ads' searches (61 interest) indicating increased platform attention

creative.headline: Can't give confident strategy—your data shows zero engagement signals
actions: I need real data to help you win. Google Trends shows 0-100 across all metrics, and there's no engagement breakdown or complaint data provided.

Before filming today, pull: Which posts got most DMs 'ADS' this week? Which Reel had highest save rate? What objections do plumbers mention? This week's actual audience insights beat any generic hook.
Avoid guessing your audience without data. Even 3-5 days of real engagement metrics (view time, DM conversion, demo request clicks) beats trends that show zero volume.
creative.source: Incomplete dataset — Google Trends all zeros, no Instagram Insights provided, no complaint/feedback log shared

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
